hook: Your mop water is the problem.
doLead: Here's the fix most people skip.
doThis: Two buckets. One soapy, one rinse.

steps.say: One bucket with cleaner, one with rinse water.
Wring the mop almost dry, mop a small area.
Rinse the mop, and change water when it looks grey.

safety.say: Don't mix floor cleaners. Skip vinegar on hardwood and stone.
safety.text: One cleaner. No vinegar on stone.
